$comment: Alerts as code (T-096, PLAN §17). Read by sentry-alerts.mjs (dry-run by default; --apply needs H-01's Sentry org) and checked by alerts.test.mjs (every event and tag named here must exist in the code, every runbook link must resolve). Explained in docs/runbooks/monitoring.md.

issueAlerts.name: [P1] Bill run job failed
issueAlerts.why: A tenant's monthly bill run (billing.run job) failed after its retries. Customers of that operator have no bill for the month until it is retried.

issueAlerts.name: [P1] Books check failed (invariant breach)
issueAlerts.why: The nightly invariants.check job found books that do not add up, or could not check a tenant (job.failed with job_type invariants.check).

issueAlerts.name: [P2] Background job failed
issueAlerts.why: Any other background job (subscription, session close, imports, …) failed after its retries.

issueAlerts.name: [P1] Cron route crashed
issueAlerts.why: A Vercel cron route threw (cronRoute captures with tag cron=<name>): e.g. the bill scheduler could not queue runs, or job-worker could not start.

issueAlerts.name: [P1] Payment sync errors spike
issueAlerts.why: The phones' payment upload (/payments:batch) hit more than 10 server errors in an hour. Payments stay safe on the phones, but they are not reaching the office.

issueAlerts.name: [P2] Razorpay webhook failed
issueAlerts.why: A signed Razorpay webhook threw while being applied (500; Razorpay retries it). Subscriptions may show the wrong state until it succeeds or the daily reconcile runs.

issueAlerts.name: [P1] App connected with an unsafe database role
issueAlerts.why: The runtime DATABASE_URL logs in as the owner or another role that can bypass RLS (checkRuntimeRole at boot).

issueAlerts.name: [P3] New error in production
issueAlerts.why: Any new kind of error, or an old one that came back. Look at it on the next working day unless it repeats.

cronMonitors.name: [P1] Nightly backup missed or failed
cronMonitors.why: The backup workflow did not check in by 21:00 UTC, or reported an error. backup.yml checks in through the secret BACKUP_SENTRY_CRON_URL.

cronMonitors.name: [P1] Bill scheduler cron missed or failed
cronMonitors.why: The daily bill scheduler (00:15 IST) did not check in within 30 minutes, ran over 6 minutes, or answered an error. On the 1st, no tenant gets this month's bill run until it runs.

cronMonitors.name: [P1] Job worker cron stopped or failing
cronMonitors.why: The job worker (every 2 minutes) missed or failed 3 check-ins in a row (about 6 minutes). Bill runs, books checks and other background jobs stay queued until it runs again.

cronMonitors.name: [P2] Books check cron missed or failed
cronMonitors.why: The nightly books check (02:30 IST) was not queued: no check-in within 30 minutes, or an error. Last night's books were not checked.

cronMonitors.name: [P2] Subscription states cron missed or failed
cronMonitors.why: The daily subscription run (06:00 IST) did not check in within 30 minutes, or failed for a tenant. Grace, read-only and reminder emails are a day late until it runs.

uptimeChecks.name: [P1] Site down (/api/health)
uptimeChecks.why: The production app does not answer /api/health with 200 (503 = degraded: the database did not answer select 1 within 2 s; a timeout = down).
